**The build passes now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) | Unset flag is now `undefined`, not `false` | Treat `undefined` as off |

`node build.js` exits 0. The 8 warnings left are all real deprecations, like `DEP0198 Buffer()` and `W1042 crypto.createCipher`. They are printed by the bundler, not by your code paths. Say the word and I'll clear those next.
